merged_current_main_working.label: ZENDOC Core Agent
merged_current_main_working.description: Permissioned agent with tool registry, audit trail, safety gate.

merged_current_main_working.label: ZENDOC Connect Messaging
merged_current_main_working.description: Policy-aware messaging, conversations, read receipts, report/video sharing and participant-protected native image/video attachments.

merged_current_main_working.label: Mental Wellness & Awareness
merged_current_main_working.description: Private self-entered check-ins and journal history with non-diagnostic, emergency-first safety boundaries.

merged_current_main_working.label: ZENDOC Health Community
merged_current_main_working.description: Health-only posts, stories, comments, reactions, follows, saved posts, reporting, blocking, author deletion and authenticated media access.

merged_current_main_working.label: Health Shop Discovery
merged_current_main_working.description: Health-focused external merchant discovery plus real outbound-click attribution; no stock, price, order or commission is fabricated.

merged_current_main_working.label: Deterministic Safety Engine
merged_current_main_working.description: Emergency detection — always first, never routed to LLM.

merged_current_main_working.label: ZENDOC Local Agent Controller
merged_current_main_working.description: Owner-scoped deterministic local control plane is working; configure a local model to add private on-device language/reasoning assistance.

merged_current_main_working.label: ZENDOC-SLM v1 Product Layer
merged_current_main_working.description: Language intelligence boundary with deterministic safety, privacy-aware routing, approved context, and validated advisory output.

merged_current_main_working.label: Approved Knowledge Layer
merged_current_main_working.description: Repository-owned ZENDOC product facts and approved synthetic safety guidance with provenance; no web retrieval.

merged_current_main_working.label: Structured Output & Safety Validator
merged_current_main_working.description: Rejects malformed or action-like model output before it reaches user-facing guidance or workflows.

merged_current_main_working.label: Model Router
merged_current_main_working.description: Routes tasks by safety, privacy, risk, complexity, and explicit cloud approval; model output cannot invoke tools.

merged_current_main_working.label: ZENDOC Model Evaluation Lab
merged_current_main_working.description: Owner-only synthetic dataset validation, dry runs, mocked scoring, safety gating, metadata-only results, and comparison reports.

merged_current_main_working.label: Agent Task Engine
merged_current_main_working.description: Persistent tasks with retry, idempotency, bounded execution.

merged_current_main_working.label: Human Approval Engine
merged_current_main_working.description: Owner-level and doctor-level human-in-the-loop approvals.

merged_current_main_working.label: Proactive Operational Alerts
merged_current_main_working.description: Deterministic monitoring: overdue tasks, high error rates, waiting approvals.

merged_current_main_working.label: Capability Registry
merged_current_main_working.description: Central truthful status for all platform features.

merged_current_main_working.label: Specialized Agent Routing v2
merged_current_main_working.description: Deterministic routing exposes assigned agent, privacy class, context requirements, human gate, expected output, and fallback strategy.

merged_current_main_working.label: CareFin Benefits Discovery
merged_current_main_working.description: Deterministic public-source discovery, missing-information analysis, provenance, and coverage truth-state enforcement.

merged_current_main_working.label: Referral & Waiting List OS
merged_current_main_working.description: Consent-bound internal referral lifecycle covers packet preparation, patient consent, send/receive, triage, accept/reject, waiting list, scheduling, consultation, report, follow-up and return to primary care. External EHR/network delivery is never inferred.

merged_current_main_working.label: Automatic Care Journey Coordinator
merged_current_main_working.description: Deterministic care-workflow state machine with human gates, provenance, next-safe-action logic, and no diagnostic authority.

merged_current_main_working.label: Evidence-Gated AI Workforce Incident Runtime
merged_current_main_working.description: Persistent incident cases automatically classify privacy-safe failures, require explicit evidence for reproduction/root cause/repair/security/tests/preview, stop at owner production approval, require live post-release health/readiness evidence, and capture sanitized learning only after verification.

merged_current_main_working.label: Safe Operations Automation
merged_current_main_working.description: Owner-only re-queue of explicitly retriable failures plus deterministic alerts; never executes arbitrary tasks or consequential clinical/financial actions.

merged_current_main_working.label: Diagnostics Freshness & Alias Layer
merged_current_main_working.description: Diagnostic aliases, observation timestamps, CONFIRMED/STALE/UNKNOWN semantics, and stale-booking rejection.

merged_current_main_working.label: Nutrition & Hydration Agent Foundation
merged_current_main_working.description: General-wellness label and normalized-price comparison with allergy flags, sponsorship separation, and medical-diet escalation.

merged_current_main_working.label: English/Bengali/Hindi Language Foundation
merged_current_main_working.description: Persistent language preference, script detection, and safety templates are working without a translation provider.

merged_current_main_working.label: Geographic Healthcare Graph v1
merged_current_main_working.description: Provenance-aware hierarchy and entity-link ingestion/search architecture is working; production starts empty until verified/official data is ingested.

merged_current_main_working.label: Official/Public Data Ingestion
merged_current_main_working.description: Owner-only dry-run/apply ingestion with checksums, explicit schema mapping, row-level rejection reasons, provenance, and idempotent upserts.

merged_current_main_working.label: Global Health Intelligence Fabric
merged_current_main_working.description: Country-aware data model covers 195 operational jurisdictions with governed source discovery, provenance, organization intelligence and truthful source-gap reporting; actual country datasets remain source-specific.

merged_current_main_working.label: Global Organization Intelligence
merged_current_main_working.description: Governed legal-entity, filing and official-source discovery plans for companies/organizations with licensing, provenance and no-private-data boundaries.

merged_current_main_working.label: ResearchAgent Global Source-Gap Automation
merged_current_main_working.description: Operations automation continuously turns missing country-source coverage into a deduplicated, bounded ResearchAgent work batch while known reviewed connectors refresh separately.

merged_current_main_working.label: Privacy-first Identity Evidence Review
merged_current_main_working.description: Consent-based masked identifier workflow stores only last 2–4 characters and keeps manual review explicitly separate from external eKYC.

merged_current_main_working.label: Provider Onboarding & Evidence Review
merged_current_main_working.description: Provider completeness scoring, evidence submission, owner evidence review, and verification-readiness state are working without auto-verifying providers.

merged_current_main_working.label: CareFin Pilot UI
merged_current_main_working.description: Authenticated browser workflow for possible-benefit discovery with explicit unverified/authoritative-verification boundaries.

merged_current_main_working.label: Care Journey Pilot UI
merged_current_main_working.description: Authenticated browser workflow for durable coordination journeys and valid next-state transitions.

merged_current_main_working.label: Pilot Analytics Scorecard
merged_current_main_working.description: Owner-only metrics computed from real ZENDOC records for onboarding, care journeys, CareFin discovery, fulfilment, diagnostics, data coverage, and operations.

merged_current_main_working.label: Health Memory & Timeline
merged_current_main_working.description: Secure personal health profile, records, timeline, analytics.

merged_current_main_working.label: Medical Records Upload
merged_current_main_working.description: Provider-backed storage interface; secure local storage is working for development.

merged_current_main_working.label: Appointments
merged_current_main_working.description: Provider scheduling, slot booking, provider profiles.

merged_current_main_working.label: AI Fitness Coach
merged_current_main_working.description: Workout plans, session tracking, exercise library, nutrition/hydration logs.

merged_current_main_working.label: Fitness Video Library
merged_current_main_working.description: Local exercise library with guidance cards.

merged_current_main_working.label: Human Operations
merged_current_main_working.description: Staff task management, status tracking (requested → completed).

merged_current_main_working.label: Family Care
merged_current_main_working.description: Remote parent care, family access grants, care tasks.

merged_current_main_working.label: Home Healthcare
merged_current_main_working.description: Service intake (actual fulfillment requires provider integration).

merged_current_main_working.label: Pharmacy Services
merged_current_main_working.description: Medicine search, delivery requests. Live dispensing requires pharmacy integration.

merged_current_main_working.label: Medical Transport
merged_current_main_working.description: Transport request intake. Live dispatch requires provider integration.

merged_current_main_working.label: IoT Hub
merged_current_main_working.description: Device registration plus a revocable, hashed, per-device ingestion bridge are implemented. Manufacturer-specific Apple/Google/Samsung/Fitbit SDK or OAuth adapters remain external vendor integrations.

merged_current_main_working.label: Healthcare Finder — ZENDOC / Official Sources
merged_current_main_working.description: Local verified-provider and ingested official/public-directory discovery are implemented. External map discovery is tracked separately because configuration does not prove provider reachability.

merged_current_main_working.label: In-App Notifications
merged_current_main_working.description: Working — delivered to user notification feed.

merged_current_main_working.label: Object Storage (S3-compatible)
merged_current_main_working.description: Local file storage works for development; hosted persistence requires verified durable object storage.

merged_current_main_working.label: Real-time Updates
merged_current_main_working.description: Authenticated incremental event polling is working. WebSocket/SSE delivery requires an external adapter.

merged_current_main_beta.label: Voice / Video Calling
merged_current_main_beta.description: Authenticated browser WebRTC signaling, call lifecycle and media controls are implemented. Enable the OCI Coturn realtime profile or configure external ICE servers for reliable public/NAT networks.

merged_current_main_beta.label: Universal Healthcare Interoperability Gateway
merged_current_main_beta.description: Provider-neutral FHIR R4/R5 and SMART-on-FHIR-compatible adapter contracts, resource normalization, truth-state reporting and plan-only exchange orchestration are implemented. External exchange remains gated.

merged_current_main_beta.label: Telehealth Beta
merged_current_main_beta.description: Consultation requests, provider acceptance, scoped Connect chat and authenticated browser WebRTC voice/video are implemented. Reliable public-network calling still depends on verified STUN/TURN infrastructure and two-device testing.

merged_current_main_beta.label: Report Intelligence
merged_current_main_beta.description: Deterministic blood test range interpretation. Not a medical diagnosis.

merged_current_main_beta.label: Fitness Camera Preview
merged_current_main_beta.description: Browser-local camera preview and duration capture only. No pose model, form analysis, rep counting, or medical-device claim.

merged_current_main_beta.label: ZENDOC Organizations & Member Benefits
merged_current_main_beta.description: Verified organization membership, benefit plans and privacy-preserving aggregate operational analytics are implemented. Organization benefit records do not prove insurer approval, provider fulfilment or clinical outcomes.

merged_current_main_beta.label: Video Intelligence
merged_current_main_beta.description: General ZENDOC guidance cards — video provider not configured.

external_integration_required.label: Durable Public Community Media
external_integration_required.description: Local media works for development; public durable video/image storage requires configured and verified object storage.

external_integration_required.label: Affiliate / Referral Revenue
external_integration_required.description: No approved affiliate templates are configured; merchant handoffs remain discovery-only.

external_integration_required.label: Connected Payments Gateway
external_integration_required.description: Real payment execution requires configured Razorpay credentials and signed webhook verification.

external_integration_required.label: ZENDOC-SLM v1 — Local Model Layer
external_integration_required.description: Local SLM integration ready — model not configured.

external_integration_required.label: Real Local Model Evaluation
external_integration_required.description: Requires an explicitly enabled evaluation gate plus an already-installed, configured local provider and candidate model.

external_integration_required.label: CareFin Live Coverage Verification
external_integration_required.description: Personal eligibility, insurer/government/CSR approval and payment confirmation require an authoritative partner response; owner evidence review remains available.

external_integration_required.label: Free-form Multilingual Translation
external_integration_required.description: Requires a configured local multilingual model or translation provider; no translation capability is fabricated.

external_integration_required.label: Live Official Dataset Connectors
external_integration_required.description: LGD/OGD/ABDM live retrieval requires dataset-specific downloads/APIs or authorized onboarding; ZENDOC does not claim live access by default.

external_integration_required.label: Live External EHR / HIE Exchange
external_integration_required.description: No external EHR/HIE adapter is live-verified. ZENDOC's software boundary is present, but external activation requires the relevant endpoint/credential, authorization or partner agreement, plus bounded live verification.

external_integration_required.label: External eKYC Provider
external_integration_required.description: No authorized eKYC provider is connected. Manual identity evidence review is available but is not eKYC.

external_integration_required.label: External Places Discovery
external_integration_required.description: External map discovery requires OpenStreetMap/Nominatim or a configured Google Places provider. Local/official Finder results remain separate.

external_integration_required.label: External Notifications (Email/SMS/WhatsApp/Push)
external_integration_required.description: In-app delivery works. SMTP email, SMS, WhatsApp and push require their real provider configuration.

external_integration_required.label: PostgreSQL Database
external_integration_required.description: Configure DATABASE_URL and complete the documented production migration and redeploy verification.

planned_future_features.label: ZENDOC Proprietary SLM (Future)
planned_future_features.description: ZENDOC has NOT trained a proprietary medical SLM. M8.2 provides evaluation and dataset-governance foundations only; adaptation remains future work.

planned_future_features.label: Autonomous Prescribing (Future, Legally Restricted)
planned_future_features.description: CRITICAL_BLOCKED — requires legally valid doctor workflow and regulatory approval.
